And His saying, Majestic and Mighty: ﴿مَا لَكُمْ مِّن مَّلْجَأٍ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَمَا لَكُمْ مِّن نَّكِيرٍ﴾.
Mujāhid said: ﴿مِّن مَّلْجَأٍ﴾: of a stronghold; and ﴿مِّن نَّكِيرٍ﴾:
of a helper.
And it was said: ﴿مِّن مَّلْجَأٍ﴾: of an escape from the punishment of Allah.
﴿وَمَا لَكُمْ مِّن نَّكِيرٍ﴾, that is, you will not be able to deny the sins with which you are confronted.

nahhas-meani:50-50.t:
And His saying, Majestic and Mighty: ﴿يَهَبُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ إِنَاثاً وَيَهَبُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ ٱلذُّكُورَ أَوْ يُزَوِّجُهُمْ ذُكْرَاناً وَإِنَاثاً وَيَجْعَلُ مَن يَشَآءُ عَقِيماً﴾.
ʿAbīda, Abū Mālik, al-Ḥasan, Mujāhid and al-Ḍaḥḥāk said
— and the wording intended is that of ʿAbīda —: that is, He grants to whom He wills males who are born to him, and no females are born to him; and He grants to whom He wills females who are born to him, and no male is born to him; ﴿أَوْ يُزَوِّجُهُمْ ذُكْرَاناً وَإِنَاثاً﴾: males are born to him and females are born to him.
ʿAbīda said: ﴿وَيَجْعَلُ مَن يَشَآءُ عَقِيماً﴾: no child is born to him.
Abū Jaʿfar said: Any two things paired together are called "zawjān" (a pair), each one
of them being a "zawj" — among these are the man and the woman, the two leather socks and the two sandals. So the meaning of ﴿يُزَوِّجُهُمْ ذُكْرَاناً وَإِنَاثاً﴾ is: He pairs them, i.e. He pairs for them — as He said
﴿وَالقَمَرَ قَدَّرْنَاهُ مَنَازِلَ﴾.
And it is said: "zawwajtu ibilī ṣaghīrahā wa-kabīrahā", i.e. I paired the young of my camels with the old.
And it is said: a man is ʿaqīm when no child is born to him, a woman is ʿaqīm when she does not give birth, and a wind is
ʿaqīm when it brings neither rain nor good.

nahhas-meani:51-51.t:
And His saying, Majestic and Mighty: ﴿وَمَا كَانَ لِبَشَرٍ أَن يُكَلِّمَهُ ٱللَّهُ إِلاَّ وَحْياً أَوْ مِن وَرَآءِ حِجَابٍ أَوْ يُرْسِلَ رَسُولاً فَيُوحِيَ بِإِذْنِهِ مَا يَشَآءُ﴾.
There are two views on the meaning:
a- That held by the people of tafsīr is what Mujāhid said; he said: ﴿إِلاَّ وَحْياً﴾:
that He breathes into his heart;
﴿أَوْ مِن وَرَآءِ حِجَابٍ﴾: as He spoke to Moses, may Allah bless him
and grant him peace; ﴿أَوْ يُرْسِلَ رَسُولاً﴾: as He sent Gabriel, peace be upon him, to the Prophet
ﷺ and to those like him.
And the other view: that the meaning of ﴿إِلاَّ وَحْياً﴾ is as revelation was given to the prophets,
may Allah bless them, by sending Gabriel, may Allah bless him; ﴿أَوْ مِن وَرَآءِ حِجَابٍ﴾:
as He spoke to Moses ﷺ; ﴿أَوْ يُرْسِلَ رَسُولاً﴾: to people in general.
And it is read ﴿أَوْ يُرْسِلُ رَسُولاً فَيوحِي بِإذْنِه﴾, and this is in the position of
a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. what takes the place of speech is what has been mentioned.
And it is possible that it is cut off from the first [i.e. a new sentence].

nahhas-meani:52-52.t:
And His saying, Majestic and Mighty: ﴿وَكَذَلِكَ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ رُوحاً مِّنْ أَمْرِنَا﴾.
Ibn ʿAbbās said: prophethood.
Abū Jaʿfar said: That is, and thus We have revealed to you that by which souls live, i.e. that by which they are guided.
Qatāda and al-Ḥasan said: ﴿رُوحاً مِّنْ أَمْرِنَا﴾, that is, a mercy from Us.
* And His saying, Majestic and Mighty: ﴿وَإِنَّكَ لَتَهْدِيۤ إِلَىٰ صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ﴾.
That is, by what We have revealed to you.
Muʿallā said: I heard Ḥawshab read ﴿وَإنَّكَ لَتُهْدَى إلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ﴾.
And in the reading of Ubayy: ﴿وَإنَّكَ لَتَدْعُو إلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ﴾.
Abū Jaʿfar said: This is not to be recited, because it contradicts the written text of the muṣḥaf (al-sawād); rather,
anything like it is understood as coming from the one who said it by way of explanation, just as
Sufyān said concerning His saying, Majestic and Mighty, ﴿وَإِنَّكَ لَتَهْدِيۤ إِلَىٰ صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ﴾: i.e. "you call".
And Maʿmar narrated from Qatāda concerning the saying of the Exalted ﴿وَإِنَّكَ لَتَهْدِيۤ إِلَىٰ صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ﴾: he said: For every people there is a guide.

safi-cedvel:10-13.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya). (ما) a jussive-governing conditional noun (ism sharṭ), in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (اختلفتم) past verb, in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). (فيه) attached to (mutaʿalliq) (اختلفتم). (من شيء) tamyīz (specification) of the pronoun in (فيه) [Note: or ḥāl (circumstantial) of it.]. (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). (إلى الله) attached to the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (حكمه). (ذلكم) mubtadaʾ, and the reference is to the Mighty Judge. (الله) the Name of Majesty, khabar [Note: or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition), or badal (substitute), with (ربّي) being the khabar of the mubtadaʾ ذلكم.]. (ربّي) a second khabar, nominative (marfūʿ) [Note: or badal of the Name of Majesty.. or naʿt (adjective) of it.]. (عليه) attached to (توكّلت). (إليه) attached to (أنيب).
The clause «ما اختلفتم ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive. The clause «اختلفتم فيه ...» is in the position of nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ (ما) [Note: It is permissible for the khabar to be the protasis and apodosis clauses together.]. The clause «حكمه إلى الله ...» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ. The clause «ذلكم الله ...» is in the position of accusative as maqūl al-qawl (the object of speech) of an implied resumptive verb of saying, i.e. "say to them" — the address being to the Messenger, upon him be peace — "That is Allah, my Lord"..
The clause «عليه توكّلت ...» is in the position of nominative as a third khabar of the mubtadaʾ ذلكم.
The clause «إليه أنيب ...» is in the position of nominative, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause توكّلت.
11- (فاطر) a fourth khabar [Note: or the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being هو, and the clause is a fourth khabar.]. (لكم) attached to an omitted second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), whose governor is جعل. (من أنفسكم) attached to a ḥāl of (أزواجا), and likewise (من الأنعام) is a ḥāl of the second (أزواجا). (فيه) attached to (يذرؤكم). (مثله) genitive (majrūr) in form, accusative (manṣūb) in position, as the khabar of ليس [Note: (المثل) may mean "the attribute", so that the kāf is not redundant, since the meaning is: there is nothing like His attribute, i.e. nothing is like His attribute.]. (شيء) the ism of ليس, postponed, nominative..
The clause «جعل ...» is in the position of nominative as a fifth khabar of the mubtadaʾ ذلكم. The clause «يذرؤكم ...» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the agent of جعل, or of the pronoun in (لكم). The clause «ليس كمثله شيء ...» is in the position of nominative as a sixth khabar.
The clause «هو السميع ...» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause ليس كمثله..
12- (له) attached to a fronted khabar of the mubtadaʾ (مقاليد). (لمن) attached to (يبسط). (بكلّ) attached to (عليم).
The clause «له مقاليد ...» is in the position of nominative as a seventh khabar. The clause «يبسط ...» is in the position of nominative as an eighth khabar. The clause «يشاء ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (من). The clause «يقدر ...» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause يبسط.
The clause «إنّه بكلّ شيء عليم ...» has no grammatical position, being a causal explanation (taʿlīl) of what preceded.
13- (لكم) attached to (شرع). (من الدين) attached to a ḥāl of ما [Note: It may be attached to (شرع), with من for the beginning of the extent (ibtidāʾ al-ghāya).]. (به) attached to (وصّى), and the agent of (وصّى) is a pronoun referring to the Name of Majesty. (الذي) in the position of accusative, conjoined to the relative noun ما. (إليك) attached to (أوحينا). (ما وصّينا به إبراهيم) is like ما وصّى به نوحا, and it is conjoined to it. (أن) a maṣdar-forming particle (ḥarf maṣdarī) [Note: or explicative (tafsīriyya), and the clause after it is explicative.]. (الواو) conjunction. (لا) prohibitive, governing the jussive. (فيه) attached to (تتفرّقوا)..
The interpreted maṣdar (أن أقيموا..) is in the position of nominative as the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being هو.. [Note: or in the position of accusative as a badal of the relative noun (ما وصّى) and what is conjoined to it.. or in the position of genitive as a badal of الدين.]
(على المشركين) attached to (كبر). (ما) relative noun, in the position of nominative as the agent (fāʿil) of كبر. (إليه) attached to (تدعوهم); the second (إليه) is attached to (يجتبي), and the third (إليه) is attached to (يهدي)..
The clause «شرع ...» is in the position of nominative as a ninth khabar. The clause «وصّى به ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the first relative noun (ما). The clause «أوحينا..» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (الذي). The clause «وصّينا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the second relative noun (ما). The clause «أقيموا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle relative (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī) (أن). The clause «لا تفرّقوا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause أقيموا ... [Translator's note: the source writes «لا تفرّقوا» here, while the verse and the i'rab above have تتفرّقوا.]
The clause «كبر ... ما تدعوهم» has no grammatical position, being resumptive. The clause «تدعوهم ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the third relative noun (ما). The clause «الله يجتبي ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive. The clause «يجتبي ...» is in the position of nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الله). The clause «يشاء ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the first relative noun (من). The clause «يهدي ...» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause يجتبي. The clause «ينيب ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the second relative noun (من).

* Benefits:
- «لَيْسَ كَمِثْلِهِ شَيْءٌ»:
The statements of the grammarians and the exegetes have diverged concerning the saying of Allah the Exalted لَيْسَ كَمِثْلِهِ شَيْءٌ in this verse, and we will cite some of the statements of the exegetes on this matter. What Imam al-Nasafī says:
It was said: the word of comparison was repeated (i.e. the kāf, meaning "like", followed by the word مثله, so that there is repetition) to negate likeness, and its implied form is: there is nothing like His like. It was also said: المثل is an addition, and its implied form is: there is nothing like Him, as in His saying (Exalted is He) فَإِنْ آمَنُوا بِمِثْلِ ما آمَنْتُمْ بِهِ; this is because what is intended is the negation of likeness, and if neither the kāf nor المثل were made an addition, it would amount to affirming a like. It was also said: what is intended is "nothing is like His Self", because they say "مثلك لا يبخل" (one such as you is not stingy), meaning to negate stinginess from his very self, and they intend hyperbole in that by taking the path of kināya (metonymy); for when they negate it from one who stands in his place, they have negated it from him. So once it is known that it belongs to the category of kināya, there is no difference between saying (ليس كالله شيء) and His saying لَيْسَ كَمِثْلِهِ شَيْءٌ, except for the benefit that kināya gives; it is as though they are two successive expressions for one meaning, namely the negation of likeness from His Self. Similar to it is: (بل يداه مبسوطتان) — its meaning is: rather, He is generous, without conceiving of a hand or its spreading out, because it has become an expression for generosity, to the point that they used it for someone who has no hand; likewise this was used both for one who has a like and for one who has no like.
What Abū al-Baqāʾ al-ʿUkbarī says:
The kāf in (كمثله) is redundant (zāʾida), i.e. there is nothing like Him, so مثله is the khabar of ليس. Were it not redundant, it would lead to an absurdity, since the meaning would be that He has a like, and that His like has no like, and that is He Himself — while affirming a like for Allah, glory be to Him, is impossible.
This is the most preponderant of the statements made about this verse. Most scholars hold it, among them Ibn Hishām. It was also said: مثل is redundant, and the implied form is: there is nothing like Him, as in His saying (Exalted is He) فَإِنْ آمَنُوا بِمِثْلِ ما آمَنْتُمْ بِهِ, as has been mentioned. This is a far-fetched statement.

safi-cedvel:14-14.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya). (ما) negating. (إلّا) for restriction (ḥaṣr). (من بعد) attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تفرّقوا). (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle (ḥarf maṣdarī).. and the interpreted maṣdar (ما جاءهم..) is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
(بغيا) mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), whose governor is تفرّقوا. (بينهم) an accusative adverb (ẓarf), attached to a naʿt (adjective) of (بغيا). (الواو) conjunction in both places. (لولا) a non-jussive conditional particle. (كلمة) mubtadaʾ (subject), and the khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being موجودة (existing). (من ربّك) attached to (سبقت) [Note: or attached to a naʿt of كلمة.]. (إلى أجل) attached to an omitted element, its implied form being (بتأخير الجزاء) (by deferring the recompense). (اللام) in the apodosis of لولا. (بينهم) an accusative adverb attached to (قضي), and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is omitted: it is the maṣdar of the verb قضى, i.e. القضاء. The wāw in (أورثوا) is the nāʾib fāʿil. (الكتاب) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb). (من بعدهم) attached to (أورثوا). (اللام) the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa) for emphasis. (في شكّ) attached to the khabar of إنّ. (منه) attached to a naʿt of (شكّ)..
The clause «ما تفرّقوا ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive. The clause «جاءهم العلم ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle relative (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī) (ما). The clause «لولا كلمة ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the resumptive clause. The clause «سبقت ...» is in the position of nominative as a naʿt of كلمة. The clause «قضى بينهم ...» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. The clause «إنّ الذين أورثوا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause. The clause «أورثوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).

safi-cedvel:15-15.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya). (لذلك) attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb understood from the context of the preceding speech, i.e.: if you and all the messengers have been called to that which We revealed to you, then call the people and stand firm [Note: It may be attached to (ادع), with its fāʾ redundant, and the clause is resumptive.]. The second (الفاء) links the apodosis of the implied condition. (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle (ḥarf maṣdarī), and the tāʾ in (أمرت) is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent)..
The interpreted maṣdar (ما أمرت) is in the position of genitive by the kāf, attached to an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) whose governor is ادع and استقم. (الواو) conjunction in both places. (لا) prohibitive, governing the jussive. (بما) attached to (آمنت), and the resumptive pronoun (ʿāʾid) of the relative is omitted. (من كتاب) tamyīz (specification) of the ʿāʾid — or a ḥāl (circumstantial) of it. (الواو) conjunction. (أمرت) like the first. (اللام) of causation (taʿlīl). (أعدل) imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām. (بينكم) an accusative adverb (ẓarf) attached to (أعدل)..
The interpreted maṣdar (أن أعدل) is in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to (أمرت). (لنا) attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) (أعمالنا), and similarly (لكم) is khabar of the mubtadaʾ (أعمالكم). (لا) the lā of generic negation. (بيننا) an accusative adverb attached to an omitted khabar of لا. (بينكم) an accusative adverb attached to what بيننا is attached to, because it is conjoined to it. The second (بيننا) is attached to (يجمع). (إليه) attached to a fronted khabar of the mubtadaʾ (المصير).
The implied conditional clause has no grammatical position, being resumptive. The clause «ادع ...» is in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), joined with the fāʾ. The clause «استقم ...» is in the position of jussive, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause ادع. The clause «لا تتّبع ...» is in the position of jussive, conjoined to the clause ادع. The clause «قل ...» is in the position of jussive, conjoined to the clause ادع. The clause «آمنت ...» is in the position of accusative as maqūl al-qawl (the object of speech). The clause «أنزل الله ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (ما). The clause «أمرت ...» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause آمنت. The clause «أعدل ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the implied particle relative (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī) (أن). The clause «الله ربّنا ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive within the scope of the speech. The clause «لنا أعمالنا ...» has no grammatical position, being another resumption within the scope of the speech. The clause «لكم أعمالكم ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause لنا أعمالنا. The clause «لا حجّة بيننا» has no grammatical position, being resumptive within the scope of the speech. The clause «الله يجمع ...» has no grammatical position, being another resumption within the scope of the speech. The clause «يجمع ...» is in the position of nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الله). The clause «إليه المصير» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause يجمع.

safi-cedvel:16-16.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya). (في الله) attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يحاجّون), with a muḍāf omitted, i.e. "concerning the religion of Allah". (من بعد) attached to (يحاجّون). (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle (ḥarf maṣdarī). (له) the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of the passive verb (استجيب)..
The interpreted maṣdar (ما استجيب له) is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
(حجّتهم) mubtadaʾ (subject), whose khabar (predicate) is (داحضة). (عند) an accusative adverb (ẓarf) attached to (داحضة). (الواو) conjunction. (عليهم) attached to a fronted khabar of the mubtadaʾ (غضب), and similarly (لهم) is khabar of the mubtadaʾ (عذاب)..
The clause «الذين يحاجّون ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive. The clause «يحاجّون ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين). The clause «استجيب له ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle relative (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī) (ما). The clause «حجّتهم داحضة ...» is in the position of nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الذين). The clause «عليهم غضب ...» is in the position of nominative, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause حجّتهم ...
The clause «لهم عذاب ...» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause حجّتهم ...

* Morphology:
(داحضة) feminine of داحض, active participle of the triliteral دحض, meaning "to be void", of the class of فتح, or meaning "to slip", of the class of نصر; its pattern is فاعل.

safi-cedvel:17-19.t:
* I'rab:
(بالحقّ) attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of الكتاب [Note: or attached to (أنزل)..]. (الميزان) conjoined (maʿṭūf) to الكتاب by (الواو), accusative (manṣūb). (الواو) conjunction. (ما) an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject).. (قريب) khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being: إتيانها (its coming) [Note: It cannot be said that in (قريب) the masculine and feminine are alike because it has the sense of فاعل, for in فعيل having the sense of فاعل the masculine and feminine are not alike.. Moreover, (الساعة) may be given the meaning of البعث (the resurrection), so that قريب is the khabar without any implied element.].
The clause «الله الذي ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive. The clause «أنزل ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذي). The clause «ما يدريك ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause. The clause «يدريك ...» is in the position of nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ (ما). The clause «لعلّ الساعة قريب ...» is in the position of accusative as the object of يدريك, which is suspended (muʿallaq) by the particle of hope. The clause «(إتيانها) قريب ...» is in the position of nominative as khabar of لعلّ.
18- (بها) attached to (يستعجل). (لا) negating. The second (بها) is attached to (يؤمنون). (الواو) conjunction. (منها) attached to (مشفقون). (أنّها) a particle resembling the verb (ḥarf mushabbah bi-l-fiʿl) and maṣdar-forming..
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّها الحقّ) is in the position of accusative, standing in place of the two objects of يعلمون. (ألا) for drawing attention (tanbīh). (في الساعة) attached to (يمارون). (اللام) the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa) for emphasis. (في ضلال) attached to the khabar of إنّ.
The clause «يستعجل بها الذين ...» has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) [Note: or in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the pronoun latent in (قريب).]. The clause «لا يؤمنون ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (الذين). The clause «الذين آمنوا مشفقون ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause يستعجل ...
The clause «آمنوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the second relative noun (الذين). The clause «يعلمون ...» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the khabar (مشفقون) [Note: or in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the pronoun in (مشفقون).. It may also be resumptive, carrying the sense of causation.]. The clause «إنّ الذين يمارون ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive. The clause «يمارون ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the third relative noun (الذين).
19- (بعباده) attached to (لطيف). (الواو) conjunction — or circumstantial (ḥāliyya)..
The clause «الله لطيف ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive. The clause «يرزق من يشاء ...» is in the position of nominative as a second khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الله). The clause «يشاء ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (من). The clause «هو القوي ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause الله لطيف [Note: or in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the agent of يرزق.].

* Morphology:
(يمارون) contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion. Its origin is يماريون: the ḍamma on the yāʾ was felt heavy, so it was made vowelless and its vowel transferred to the rāʾ before it — iʿlāl by making vowelless — then the yāʾ, the lām (third radical) of the word, was deleted because of the meeting of two vowelless letters, and it became يمارون; its pattern is يفاعون.

* Benefits:
- Multiplicity of the khabar, the ḥāl and the adjective..
The khabar is multiple in this noble verse, in the saying of Allah the Exalted:
اللَّهُ لَطِيفٌ بِعِبادِهِ يَرْزُقُ مَنْ يَشاءُ — so (لطيف) is a first khabar and the clause يرزق is a second khabar. Likewise in His saying وَهُوَ الْقَوِيُّ الْعَزِيزُ, القوي is a first khabar and العزيز a second khabar. Therefore:
1- The khabar may be multiple, without limitation to a specific number, whether it is a single word, a clause, or a quasi-clause (shibh jumla).
1- A single word, e.g.: (الله قوى عزيز سميع بصير عليم ...)
2- A verbal clause: (الله يرزق يخلق يمنح يحيي يميت)
3- A nominal clause: (الإيمان أفياؤه نديّة، أنسامه عليلة) (faith: its shades are dewy, its breezes gentle).
4- A quasi-clause, i.e. (an adverb or a preposition and its genitive noun): القرية فوق تل، عند المنعطف، على شاطئ الوادي (the village is on a hill, at the bend, on the bank of the valley). Here the first adverb فوق is attached to an omitted first khabar, its implied form being كائنة, the second adverb (عند) is attached to an omitted second khabar, and the preposition and its genitive noun (على شاطئ الوادي) are attached to a third khabar.
2- It is not a condition for multiplicity of the khabar that the khabar be of one type; the khabars in a sentence may be multiple and varied, e.g.: الله سميع- بصير- قوى- يخلق- يرزق ... etc..
3- Likewise the ḥāl may be multiple in all its forms, e.g.: أقبل الفلاح نشيطا- مسرورا- يحمل فأسه- يقود حصانه (the farmer came forward, energetic, happy, carrying his axe, leading his horse).. so (نشيطا) is a first ḥāl, (مسرور) a second ḥāl, (يحمل فأسه) a verbal clause as a third ḥāl, and (يقود حصانه) a verbal clause as a fourth ḥāl..
4- Likewise the adjective may be multiple, whether a single word, a clause, or a quasi-clause, e.g.: (هذا بستان- جميل- رائع- بديع- أفياؤه ندية- ثماره يانعة- يجود بالخير..) (this is a garden — beautiful, splendid, wonderful, its shades dewy, its fruits ripe, generous with good..)
An important remark..
1- Sometimes it is permissible to parse the second khabar and what follows it as adjectives of the first khabar, e.g.: محمد رسول كريم شجاع كامل; it is permissible to parse كريم as a second khabar, شجاع as a third khabar and كامل as a fourth khabar, and it is permissible to parse كريم, شجاع and كامل as adjectives of رسول.
2- Sometimes it is only permissible to parse them as khabars, e.g.: الكتب:
دينية- سياسية- أخلاقية.. (the books are religious, political, ethical..)
So (دينية, سياسية and أخلاقية) are khabars, and it is not permissible to regard سياسية and أخلاقية as adjectives of دينية, because the meaning would be corrupted; the matter turns on whether the meaning is sound or corrupt.
3- The rule applying to the khabar applies to the khabar of kāna and its sisters and of inna and its sisters.

safi-cedvel:20-20.t:
* I'rab:
(من) a jussive-governing conditional noun (ism sharṭ), in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (كان) incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). (له) attached to (mutaʿalliq) (نزد). (في حرثه) attached to (نزد). (الواو) conjunction. (من كان.. نؤته) is like من كان ... نزد. (منها) attached to (نؤته). (الواو) conjunction. (ما) negating. (له) attached to a fronted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (نصيب). (في الآخرة) attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of (نصيب), which is genitive in form and nominative in position..
The clause «من كان ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive. The clause «كان يريد ...» is in the position of nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ [Note: It is permissible for the khabar to be the protasis and apodosis clauses together.]. The clause «يريد ...» is in the position of accusative as khabar of كان. The clause «نزد ...» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) not joined with the fāʾ. The clause «من كان (the second) ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the resumptive clause. The clause «كان (the second)» is in the position of nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) [Note: It is permissible for the khabar to be the protasis and apodosis clauses together.]. The clause «يريد ...» is in the position of accusative as khabar of كان. The clause «نؤته منها ...» has no grammatical position, being the (second) apodosis, not joined with the fāʾ. The clause «ما له في الآخرة من نصيب» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause نؤته منها.

* Rhetoric:
Explicit metaphor (al-istiʿāra al-taṣrīḥiyya): in the saying of Allah the Exalted «مَنْ كانَ يُرِيدُ حَرْثَ الْآخِرَةِ».
الحرث originally means casting seed into the ground, and it is applied to the crop resulting from it. Here it has been used for the fruits of deeds and their results, by way of explicit metaphor built on likening them to the yields obtained from seeds, and it includes likening deeds to seeds; i.e. whoever desires by his deeds the reward of the Hereafter, We multiply his reward for him, ten for one up to seven hundred and beyond.

safi-cedvel:21-21.t:
* I'rab:
(أم) it is the disconnected (munqaṭiʿa) one, meaning بل, which is for transition, or with the hamza implied with it, which is for rebuke. (لهم) attached to (mutaʿalliq) a fronted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) (شركاء). (لهم) attached to (شرعوا). (من الدين) attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of ما [Note: or attached to (شرعوا).]. (به) attached to (يأذن). (الواو) conjunction in both places. (لولا ... لقضي بينهم) — the i'rab of its parallel has already been given [Note: in verse (14) of this sura.]. (لهم) attached to a fronted khabar of the mubtadaʾ (عذاب).
The clause «لهم شركاء ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive. The clause «شرعوا ...» is in the position of nominative as a naʿt (adjective) of شركاء. The clause «لم يأذن به الله ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (ما). The clause «لولا كلمة ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the resumptive clause. The clause «قضي بينهم ...» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. The clause «إنّ الظالمين ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause. The clause «لهم عذاب ...» is in the position of nominative as khabar of إنّ.

safi-cedvel:22-23.t:
* I'rab:
(مشفقين) ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative (manṣūba). (ممّا) attached to (mutaʿalliq) (مشفقين), and the resumptive pronoun (ʿāʾid) is omitted. (الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya). (بهم) attached to (واقع). (الواو) resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya). (في روضات) attached to the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) (الذين). (لهم) attached to a fronted khabar of the mubtadaʾ (ما). (عند) an accusative adverb (ẓarf) attached to (يشاءون) [Note: or attached to a ḥāl of the implied ʿāʾid, i.e. what they wish to exist with their Lord.]. (ذلك) mubtadaʾ, and the reference is to what has been prepared for those who believed. (هو) separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl) [Note: or it is a second mubtadaʾ whose khabar is الفضل.. and the nominal clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ ذلك.]. (الفضل) khabar of ذلك.
The clause «ترى الظالمين ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive. The clause «كسبوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (ما). The clause «هو واقع بهم ...» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the object of كسبوا. The clause «الذين آمنوا ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive. The clause «آمنوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (الذين). The clause «عملوا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause آمنوا. The clause «لهم ما يشاءون ...» is in the position of nominative as a second khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الذين). The clause «ذلك ... الفضل» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
23- The ʿāʾid of the relative noun (الذي) is omitted, i.e. يبشر به (gives good tidings of it).. (الذين) relative noun, in the position of accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of عباد. (لا) negating. (عليه) attached to a ḥāl of (أجرا). (إلّا) for exception. (المودّة) a noun, accusative on the disconnected exception (al-istithnāʾ al-munqaṭiʿ)» [Translator's note: the stray closing quotation mark is in the source.], (في القربى) attached to a ḥāl of المودّة. (الواو) resumptive. (من) a jussive-governing conditional noun (ism sharṭ), in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ. (له) attached to (نزد). (فيها) attached to (نزد). (شكور) a second khabar of the particle resembling the verb إنّ.
The clause «ذلك الذي ...» has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) [Note: It may be a badal (substitute) of the clause ذلك ... الفضل.]. The clause «يبشّر الله ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (الذي). The clause «آمنوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (الذين). The clause «عملوا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause آمنوا. The clause «قل ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive. The clause «لا أسألكم ...» is in the position of accusative as maqūl al-qawl (the object of speech). The clause «من يقترف ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive. The clause «يقترف ...» is in the position of nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) [Note: It is permissible for the khabar to be the protasis and apodosis clauses together.]. The clause «نزد له ...» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) not joined with the fāʾ. The clause «إنّ الله غفور ...» has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption.

* Rhetoric:
Synecdoche-type figurative usage (al-majāz al-mursal): in the saying of Allah the Exalted «إِلَّا الْمَوَدَّةَ فِي الْقُرْبى».
They made [the kinship] a place for affection and a seat for it, as when you say: لي في آل فلان مودّة، ولي فيهم هوى وحب شديد (I have affection among the family of so-and-so, and I have among them fondness and intense love), meaning that you love them and they are the place and location of your love; so the relation is that of place (maḥalliyya).
The meaning is: you are my people, and the most deserving to answer me and obey me; so since you have refused that, then preserve the right of kinship, keep the ties of kinship with me, and do not harm me.

* Benefits:
- The excepted (mustathnā) with (إلّا) and its ruling:
a- The excepted with (إلّا) must be put in the accusative if the speech is affirmative and that from which the exception is made (al-mustathnā minhu) is mentioned:
e.g. (فَشَرِبُوا مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا مِنْهُمْ).
b- It is permissible to put the excepted with (إلّا) in the accusative, or to make it follow the mustathnā minhu in its case as a badal of it, if the speech is negative and the mustathnā minhu is mentioned. An example of that is the saying of Allah the Exalted: (ما فَعَلُوهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلٌ مِنْهُمْ) in the nominative as a badal, or (ما فعلوه إلا قليلا منهم) in the accusative on exception.
c- The excepted with (إلّا) is parsed according to its position in the sentence if the speech is negative and the mustathnā minhu is not mentioned, and (إلا) then has no governing effect. It may occur as:
1- A khabar: as in the saying of Allah the Exalted (وَما مُحَمَّدٌ إِلَّا رَسُولٌ) — الرسول: khabar, nominative.
2- A mubtadaʾ: as in the saying of Allah the Exalted (ما عَلَى الرَّسُولِ إِلَّا الْبَلاغُ الْمُبِينُ) — البلاغ: mubtadaʾ, nominative.
3- A fāʿil (agent): e.g. (ما رفع مقام الوطن إلّا العلم والعمل) (nothing raised the standing of the homeland except knowledge and work) — العلم: fāʿil, nominative with the ḍamma.
4- A mafʿūl bihi (direct object): e.g. (ما قلت إلّا كلمة الصدق) (I said nothing but the word of truth) — كلمة: mafʿūl bihi, accusative.
5- If the excepted precedes the mustathnā minhu, it must be put in the accusative absolutely, i.e. whether the exception is disconnected, e.g. (قُلْ لا أَسْئَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ أَجْراً إِلَّا الْمَوَدَّةَ فِي الْقُرْبى), or connected (muttaṣil), e.g. (ما قام إلا زيدا القوم).

safi-cedvel:24-24.t:
* I'rab:
(أم) it is the disconnected (munqaṭiʿa) one, meaning بل. (على الله) attached to (mutaʿalliq) (افترى). (كذبا) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) [Note: or it is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar that agrees with it in meaning.]. (الفاء) resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya). (على قلبك) attached to (يختم). (الواو) resumptive. (يمح) imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the sign of the nominative is the implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the deleted wāw, in observance of its deletion in pronunciation. (بكلماته) attached to (يحقّ). (بذات) attached to (عليم)..
The clause «يقولون ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive. The clause «افترى ...» is in the position of accusative as maqūl al-qawl (the object of speech). The clause «يشأ الله ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive. The clause «يختم ...» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) not joined with the fāʾ. The clause «يمحو الله ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive. The clause «يحقّ الحقّ ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause يمحو الله. The clause «إنّه عليم ...» has no grammatical position, being causal (taʿlīliyya).

safi-cedvel:25-26.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya). (عن عباده) attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يقبل) [Note: قبل يقبل — of the class of فرح — is made transitive to the second object with الباء and عن.. It is stated in Lisān al-ʿArab:
«قبل الشيء قبولا — with fatḥa on the qāf — and قبولا — with ḍamma on it — and تقبّله: both mean he took it. And Allah, Mighty and Majestic, accepts deeds from His servants (من عباده and عنهم) and receives them (يتقبّلها). And in the Revelation: (أولئك الذين نتقبّل عنهم أحسن ما عملوا).» End quote.]. (عن السيّئات) attached to (يعفو). (ما) relative noun, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the resumptive pronoun (ʿāʾid) is omitted.
The clause «هو الذي ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive. The clause «يقبل ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذي). The clause «يعفو ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the ṣila clause. The clause «يعلم ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the ṣila clause. The clause «تفعلون ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (ما).
26- (الواو) conjunction in the four places. (من فضله) attached to (يزيدهم) [Note: The occurrence of the verb (يزيدهم) conjoined to (يستجيب) indicates that the latter means يجيب (He answers), so the agent is a pronoun referring to Allah and the relative noun is the mafʿūl bihi.. The verb (يستجيب) may also keep its own meaning, so that the relative noun is the agent, i.e. those who believed submit, or answer their Lord when He calls them.]. (لهم) attached to a fronted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) (عذاب)..
The clause «يستجيب الذين ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause هو الذي....
The clause «آمنوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (الذين). The clause «عملوا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the ṣila clause. The clause «يزيدهم ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause يستجيب. The clause «الكافرون لهم عذاب» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause يستجيب [Note: The clause may be resumptive in origin, without conjunction.].

* Benefits:
- Mention of repentance and its ruling ...
The scholars said: repentance is obligatory from every sin. If the act of disobedience is between the servant and Allah the Exalted, not relating to a right of a human being, it has three conditions:
1- That he desist from the sin.
2- That he regret having done it.
3- That he resolve never to return to it.
If these conditions are fulfilled, the repentance is valid; and if one of the three is missing, his repentance is not valid.
It should be known that he must make up the prayer and fasting he has missed. If the act of disobedience relates to a right of a human being, it has the same preceding conditions, plus a fourth condition: that he free himself of the right of its owner. In defining repentance it was said: keeping away from acts of disobedience in intention and in deed, and turning to acts of obedience in intention and in deed.
From Abū Hurayra, may Allah be pleased with him, who said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: "By Allah, I seek Allah's forgiveness and repent to Him more than seventy times a day."
From ʿAbd Allāh ibn Masʿūd, may Allah be pleased with him, who said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: "Allah is more joyful at the repentance of His believing servant than a man who stopped in a desolate (دوية, i.e. desert), perilous land, having with him his mount carrying his food and drink. He laid down his head and slept a sleep, then woke up and his mount had gone. He searched for it until, when the heat and thirst became severe — or whatever Allah willed — he said: I will return to my place where I was and sleep until I die. So he laid his head on his forearm to die, then he woke up, and there was his mount beside him, carrying his food and drink. Allah is more joyful at the repentance of the servant than this man at his mount and his provisions."

safi-cedvel:27-27.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya). (لو) a non-jussive conditional particle. (لعباده) attached to (mutaʿalliq) (بسط). (اللام) linking the apodosis of لو. (بغوا) past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma implied on the alif that was deleted because of the meeting of two vowelless letters ... and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (في الأرض) attached to (بغوا). (الواو) conjunction. (لكن) for rectification (istidrāk), with no governing effect. (بقدر) attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of ما. (ما) relative noun, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (بعباده) attached to (خبير and بصير).
The clause «لو بسط الله ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive. The clause «بغوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. The clause «ينزل ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the resumptive clause. The clause «يشاء ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (ما). The clause «إنّه ... خبير ...» has no grammatical position, being causal (taʿlīliyya) — or an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).

* Morphology:
(بغوا) contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion. Its origin is بغاوا: two vowelless letters met, so the alif — the lām (third radical) of the word — was deleted; its pattern is فعوا.

safi-cedvel:28-29.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya). (من بعد) attached to (mutaʿalliq) (ينزّل). (الواو) conjunction in both places. (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle (ḥarf maṣdarī).. and the interpreted maṣdar (ما قنطوا) is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
The clause «هو الذي ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive. The clause «ينزّل ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذي). The clause «قنطوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle relative (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī) (ما). The clause «ينشر ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause ينزّل. The clause «هو الوليّ ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause هو الذي ...
29- (الواو) conjunction in the four places. (من آياته) attached to a fronted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) (خلق). (فيهما) attached to (بثّ). (من دابّة) tamyīz (specification) of ما [Note: or a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the omitted resumptive pronoun, i.e. what He spread in them of creatures.]. (على جمعهم) attached to (قدير). (إذا) an adverb in the position of accusative, stripped of the conditional sense, attached to (جمعهم).
The clause «من آياته خلق ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause هو الولي. The clause «بثّ ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (ما). The clause «هو ... قدير» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause من آياته خلق ...
The clause «يشاء ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.

* Rhetoric:
1- The art of sound explanation (ṣiḥḥat al-tafsīr): in the saying of Allah the Exalted «وَهُوَ الَّذِي يُنَزِّلُ الْغَيْثَ مِنْ بَعْدِ ما قَنَطُوا».
The meaning of this art is that the speaker brings, at the beginning of his speech, a meaning whose import cannot be grasped on its own: either it is general (mujmal) and needs detailing, or it is open to interpretation (muwajjah) and needs directing. Sound explanation has come in the verse announcing the coming of hope after despair, relief after hardship, and joy after sorrow. And there is no scene that shakes off the cares of the heart and the fatigue of the soul like the scene of the earth opening up with vegetation after the rain, and becoming exhilarated with greenery after lifelessness.
2- Attributing a thing to the whole while meaning the part: in the saying of Allah the Exalted «وَما بَثَّ فِيهِما مِنْ دابَّةٍ».
It is permissible to attribute a thing to the entirety of what is mentioned even if it is connected with only part of it, as it is said: بنو تميم فيهم شاعر مجيد أو شجاع بطل (among the Banū Tamīm is an excellent poet, or a heroic brave man), when he belongs only to one of their sub-clans or one of their branches; and "Banū so-and-so did such-and-such" when only one of them did it. Of this kind is the saying of Allah the Exalted «يَخْرُجُ مِنْهُمَا اللُّؤْلُؤُ وَالْمَرْجانُ», whereas they come out only from the salt water.

safi-cedvel:30-31.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya). (ما) a jussive-governing conditional noun (ism sharṭ), in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject) [Note: It may be a relative noun as mubtadaʾ, with the fāʾ added in its khabar (بما كسبت أيديكم..) because of the resemblance of the relative noun to the condition.]. (أصابكم) indeclinable (mabnī) past verb, in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). (من مصيبة) tamyīz (specification) of ما [Note: or a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the latent agent of أصابكم.]. (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). (بما) attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of an implied mubtadaʾ, i.e.:
"your being afflicted is because of what your hands have earned", so the bāʾ is causal and the resumptive pronoun (ʿāʾid) is omitted. (الواو) parenthetical (iʿtirāḍiyya). (عن كثير) attached to (يعفو).
The clause «ما أصابكم ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive. The clause «أصابكم ...» is in the position of nominative as khabar of ما [Note: It is permissible for the khabar to be the protasis and apodosis clauses together ... and it is the ṣila (relative clause) of ما if it is a relative noun.]. The clause «(إصابتكم) بما كسبت ...» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ. The clause «يعفو ...» has no grammatical position, being parenthetical.
The clause «كسبت أيديكم» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (ما).
31- (الواو) conjunction. (ما) negating, governing like ليس. (معجزين) genitive in form, accusative in position, as the khabar of ما. (في الأرض) attached to (معجزين). The second (ما) is negating, non-governing (muhmala). (لكم) attached to a fronted khabar of the mubtadaʾ (وليّ). (من دون) attached to a ḥāl of وليّ. (وليّ) genitive in form, nominative in position, mubtadaʾ. (لا) redundant (zāʾida) for emphasizing the negation. (نصير) conjoined (maʿṭūf) to وليّ by the wāw, following it in the genitive in form and in the nominative in position.
The clause «ما أنتم بمعجزين ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause. The clause «ما لكم ... من وليّ» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause ما أنتم بمعجزين.

* Benefits:
- What you sow, you reap ...
This verse has made clear that the afflictions that befall a person are only the result of the sins and misdeeds he commits, even though Allah, Mighty and Majestic, pardons much and does not call to account for everything — otherwise He would not leave on its surface any creature, as has passed in another verse.
Ibn ʿAbbās said: When this verse was revealed, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "By the One in whose hand my soul is, there is no scratch of a stick, nor stumble of a foot, nor twitching of a vein, except because of a sin, and what Allah pardons is more." And it is narrated from ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib, may Allah be pleased with him: "Shall I not tell you of the best verse in the Book of Allah? The Messenger of Allah ﷺ told us of it: (وَما أَصابَكُمْ مِنْ مُصِيبَةٍ فَبِما كَسَبَتْ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَيَعْفُوا عَنْ كَثِيرٍ), and I will explain it to you: whatever affliction befalls you — i.e. illness, punishment or trial in this world — it is because of what your hands have earned; and Allah is too generous to repeat the punishment upon you in the Hereafter. And what Allah has pardoned in this world, Allah is too forbearing to return to after His pardon." From ʿĀʾisha, may Allah be pleased with her, who said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "No thorn, or anything greater, afflicts the believer except that Allah raises him by it a degree and removes from him by it a sin." How great is the generosity of Allah, Mighty and Majestic, and how sublime is His kindness to His servants.

safi-cedvel:32-35.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction. (من آياته الجوار) — the i'rab of its parallel has already been given [Note: in verse (29) of this sura.], and the sign of the nominative in (الجوار) is the ḍamma implied on the deleted yāʾ, in keeping with the reading in continuous recitation (al-waṣl). (في البحر) attached to (mutaʿalliq) (الجواري) [Note: or to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of الجواري, on the view that it is a non-derived (jāmid) noun and not a derived adjective.]. (كالأعلام) attached to a ḥāl of الجواري.
The clause «من آياته الجواري ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the resumption that preceded in the clause ما أصابكم ... [Note: in verse (30) of this sura.]
33- (يسكن) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and it was given a kasra because of the meeting of two vowelless letters. (الفاء) conjunction. (يظللن) imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of jussive, conjoined to (يسكن), and (النون) is a pronoun as its ism, referring to الجواري. (على ظهره) attached to (رواكد). (في ذلك) attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of (إنّ). (اللام) for emphasis. (آيات) the ism of إنّ, postponed, accusative (manṣūb), and the sign of the accusative is the kasra. (لكلّ) attached to a naʿt (adjective) of (آيات).. (شكور) naʿt of كلّ صبّار..
The clause «يشأ ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive. The clause «يسكن ...» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis not joined with the fāʾ. The clause «يظللن ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause يسكن. The clause «إنّ في ذلك لآيات» has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
34- (أو) conjunction. (يوبقهنّ) imperfect verb, jussive, conjoined to (يظللن) in position.. (هنّ) is mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the agent is هو, i.e. Allah. (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle (ḥarf maṣdarī) [Note: or a relative noun in the position of genitive, with the resumptive pronoun omitted.. and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.], and (الواو) in (كسبوا) refers to the owners of the ships, understood from the context..
The interpreted maṣdar (ما كسبوا..) is in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (يوبقهنّ). (الواو) conjunction. (يعف) imperfect verb, jussive, conjoined to the apodosis [Note: i.e.: if He wills He destroys, and if He wills He saves by pardon.]. (عن كثير) attached to (يعف).
The clause «يوبقهنّ ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause يظللن. The clause «كسبوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle relative (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī) (ما). The clause «يعف ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause يوبقهنّ.
35- (الواو) conjunction. (يعلم) imperfect verb, accusative, conjoined to an omitted accusative verb of causation, i.e.: He drowns them in order to take vengeance on them and so that ... may know. (الذين) relative noun, in the position of nominative as the fāʿil (agent) of يعلم. (في آياتنا) attached to (يجادلون). (ما) negating, non-governing (muhmala) [Note: The author, may Allah have mercy on him, did not mention that it may govern like ليس (see the Benefits on the following page).]. (لهم) attached to a fronted khabar. (محيص) genitive in form, nominative in position, mubtadaʾ (subject).
The clause «يعلم الذين يجادلون» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the implied ṣila clause of the particle relative, i.e.: in order that (أن) Allah take vengeance on them and that those ... may know.
The clause «يجادلون ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (الذين). The clause «ما لهم من محيص» is in the position of accusative, standing in place of the two objects of the verb of knowing, which is suspended (muʿallaq) by the negative ما.

* Morphology:
(32) الجوار: plural of الجارية, feminine of الجاري, active participle of the triliteral جرى; its pattern is فاعل, and the pattern of الجواري is الفواعل; they are the running ships. It may be intended as a non-derived noun for ships, using the adjective as a noun.. As for الجوار, its pattern is الفواع, with the (yāʾ) dropped for the reading in continuous recitation.
(الأعلام) plural of علم, which is the mountain; a non-derived noun whose pattern is فعل with two fatḥas, and the pattern of الأعلام is أفعال.
(33) رواكد: plural of راكدة, feminine of راكد, active participle of the triliteral ركد, meaning "to stand still"; its pattern is فاعل, and the pattern of رواكد is فواعل.
(34) يعف: contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion on account of the jussive: the weak letter was deleted from its end; its pattern is يفع, with ḍamma on the ʿayn.

* Rhetoric:
Allah the Exalted said «إِنْ يَشَأْ يُسْكِنِ الرِّيحَ فَيَظْلَلْنَ رَواكِدَ عَلى ظَهْرِهِ». They say that الريح (the wind, singular) occurs in the Quran only as punishment, unlike الرياح (the winds).
This verse breaks that generalization, for the wind mentioned here is a blessing and a mercy, since by means of it Allah makes the ships travel on the sea, such that if it became still the ships would stand motionless. It is not denied that what they mentioned is the predominant case of its occurrence in the singular, but that it holds without exception — no. As for what occurs in the hadith: "O Allah, make it winds (رياحا) and do not make it a wind (ريحا)", that is on account of the predominant case in general usage; and Allah knows best.

* Benefits:
- ما: the negating particle governing like ليس ...
In this verse occurs the saying of Allah the Exalted ما لَهُمْ مِنْ مَحِيصٍ — ما: negating, governing like ليس; لهم are attached to its fronted khabar; and محيص is genitive in form, nominative in position, as the ism of ما. We will clarify below what relates to (ما) governing like ليس.
(ما) governs in this way under four conditions:
1- That its ism come first and its khabar after it.
2- That the ism not be accompanied by (the redundant إن), as in the saying of the poet:
بني غدانة ما إن أنتم ذهب ... ولا صريف ولكن أنتم الخزف
(O Banū Ghudāna, you are not gold, nor pure silver; rather you are pottery.)
3- That the khabar not be accompanied by إلا, e.g.: ما أنت إلا شاعر.
4- That it not be followed by a dependent (maʿmūl) of the khabar, except for an adverb or a preposition and its genitive noun.
E.g.: ما كلّ مسيء معاقب. مسيء is a dependent of the khabar معاقب, because معاقب is a passive participle that requires a nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
[Translator's note: the explanation is as in the source; in ما كلّ مسيء معاقب the word following ما is كلّ, which is not a dependent of the khabar.]
If these conditions are fulfilled, it governs, whether its ism and khabar are both indefinite, as in the saying of Allah the Exalted: فَما مِنْكُمْ مِنْ أَحَدٍ عَنْهُ حاجِزِينَ — أحد is its ism and حاجزين its khabar, and (منكم) is attached to an omitted element, its implied form being أعني (I mean). Likewise (ما) governs if its ism and khabar are both definite, as in the saying of Allah the Exalted: ما هُنَّ أُمَّهاتِهِمْ; and likewise if the ism is definite and the khabar indefinite, as in the saying of Allah the Exalted: ما هذا بَشَراً.

safi-cedvel:36-39.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya). (ما) a jussive-governing conditional noun (ism sharṭ), in the position of accusative as a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (أوتيتم) passive past verb, in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). (من شيء) tamyīz (specification) of ما [Note: or attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of ما.]. (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). (متاع) khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being هو. (الواو) conjunction. (ما) relative noun, mubtadaʾ. (عند) an accusative adverb (ẓarf) attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣila of ما. (للذين) attached to (أبقى). (على ربّهم) attached to (يتوكّلون).
The clause «أوتيتم ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive. The clause «(هو) متاع ...» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ. The clause «ما عند الله خير ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the resumptive clause. The clause «آمنوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the first relative noun (الذين). The clause «يتوكّلون» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the ṣila clause.
37- (الواو) conjunction in the three places. (الذين) relative noun, in the position of genitive, conjoined to the preceding relative noun. (إذا) an adverb of future time, stripped of the conditional sense, attached to (يغفرون) [Note: The adverb may include the sense of condition, so that its apodosis is the verbal clause يغفرون, and (هم) is an emphasizing pronoun for the agent of غضبوا.. or it is the agent of an omitted verb explained by what follows it; when the verb was omitted, the agent became detached.]. (ما) redundant (zāʾida). (هم) detached pronoun, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ.
The clause «يجتنبون ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the second relative noun (الذين). The clause «غضبوا ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct)..
The clause «هم يغفرون ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the ṣila clause يجتنبون. The clause «يغفرون ...» is in the position of nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ (هم).
38- (الواو) conjunction in the four places. (الذين) relative noun, conjoined to the last relative noun, in the position of genitive. (لربّهم) attached to (استجابوا). (بينهم) an accusative adverb attached to (شورى). (ممّا) attached to (ينفقون).
The clause «استجابوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the third relative noun (الذين). The clause «أقاموا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause استجابوا. The clause «أمرهم شورى ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause استجابوا. The clause «رزقناهم ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (ما). The clause «ينفقون» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause استجابوا.
39- (الواو) conjunction. (الذين) relative noun, in the position of genitive, conjoined to the last relative noun. (إذا) like the first «1». (هم ينتصرون) like هم يغفرون «2».. [Translator's note: the footnote markers «1» and «2» appear in the source without their footnote text.]
The clause «أصابهم البغي ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. The clause «هم ينتصرون ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the fourth relative noun (الذين). The clause «ينتصرون ...» is in the position of nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ (هم).

* Morphology:
(37) كبائر: plural of كبيرة or كبير.. see verse (45) of Sūrat al-Baqara or verse (217) of it.
(38) شورى: a quasi-maṣdar (ism maṣdar) of the five-letter verb تشاور, i.e. in the sense of التشاور (mutual consultation); its pattern is فعلى, with ḍamma then sukūn, like بشرى.

safi-cedvel:40-43.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya). (مثلها) naʿt (adjective) of the second سيّئة, nominative (marfūʿ). (الفاء) conjunction. (من) a jussive-governing conditional noun (ism sharṭ), mubtadaʾ (subject), in the position of nominative. (عفا) past verb, in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and likewise (أصلح). (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). (على الله) attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. (لا) negating.
The clause «جزاء سيّئة سيّئة ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive. The clause «من عفا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the resumptive clause. The clause «عفا ...» is in the position of nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من). The clause «أصلح ...» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause عفا. The clause «أجره على الله ...» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ. The clause «إنّه لا يحب الظالمين» has no grammatical position, being causal (taʿlīliyya).
41- (الواو) conjunction. (اللام) of inception (lām al-ibtidāʾ). (من انتصر) like من عفا. (بعد) an accusative adverb (ẓarf) attached to (انتصر). (الفاء) linking the apodosis. (ما) negating, non-governing (muhmala). (عليهم) attached to a fronted khabar. (سبيل) genitive in form, nominative in position, a postponed mubtadaʾ.
The clause «من انتصر ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause من عفا. The clause «انتصر ...» is in the position of nominative as khabar of the second mubtadaʾ (من). The clause «أولئك ما عليهم من سبيل» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ. The clause «ما عليهم من سبيل» is in the position of nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ (أولئك).
42- (إنّما) the restraining and restrained particle (kāffa wa-makfūfa). (على الذين) attached to the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (السبيل). (في الأرض) attached to (يبغون). (بغير) attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the agent of يبغون. (لهم) a fronted khabar of the mubtadaʾ (عذاب)..
The clause «السبيل على الذين ...» has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī). The clause «يظلمون ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين). The clause «يبغون ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause يظلمون. The clause «أولئك لهم عذاب ...» has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption. The clause «لهم عذاب ...» is in the position of nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ (أولئك).
43- (الواو) conjunction. (لمن صبر) like لمن انتصر. (اللام) the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa) for emphasis. (من عزم) attached to the khabar of إنّ.
The clause «من صبر ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause من انتصر. The clause «صبر ...» is in the position of nominative as khabar of the third mubtadaʾ (من) [Note: It is also permissible for the khabar of (من) to be the protasis and apodosis clauses together.].
The clause «غفر ...» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause صبر. The clause «إنّ ذلك لمن عزم ...» has no grammatical position, being a causal explanation of the implied apodosis, i.e. whoever is patient is a person of resolve; indeed that is of the matters requiring resolve.

* Rhetoric:
1- Paronomasia of pairing (jinās al-muzāwaja): in the saying of Allah the Exalted «وَجَزاءُ سَيِّئَةٍ سَيِّئَةٌ مِثْلُها».
Both acts — the first and its recompense — are سيئة (evil), because it grieves (تسوء) the one upon whom it falls, and it has been called by its name for the purpose of pairing. Similar to it is the saying of Allah the Exalted «فَمَنِ اعْتَدى عَلَيْكُمْ فَاعْتَدُوا عَلَيْهِ بِمِثْلِ مَا اعْتَدى عَلَيْكُمْ». The meaning is that when an offence is requited, it must be requited with its like without excess; so if someone says "May Allah disgrace you", he says "May Allah disgrace you". Some express it as mushākala (verbal assimilation).
2- The art of refinement (al-tahdhīb): in the saying of Allah the Exalted: «فَمَنْ عَفا وَأَصْلَحَ فَأَجْرُهُ عَلَى اللَّهِ إِنَّهُ لا يُحِبُّ الظَّالِمِينَ».
This art is that, when the act is ascribed to Allah the Exalted, one should turn away from ascribing evil to Him, as in the saying of Allah the Exalted on the tongue of Ibrāhīm, upon him be peace: «وَإِذا مَرِضْتُ فَهُوَ يَشْفِينِ», where he ascribed the illness to himself and ascribed the healing to his Lord, glory be to Him, the Exalted.
This is of the category of adhering to proper conduct (adab) with Allah, glory be to Him.
In the verse we are dealing with there is a lofty art, which is also tahdhīb: in retaliation one can hardly be safe from exceeding the evil and transgressing, especially in a state of agitation, boiling and inflamed zeal. In this is an answer to whoever asks: what is the meaning of mentioning wrongdoing after pardon, although retaliation is not wrongdoing? This is like the saying of Allah the Exalted «وَقالَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِنَّ الْخاسِرِينَ الَّذِينَ خَسِرُوا أَنْفُسَهُمْ وَأَهْلِيهِمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيامَةِ أَلا إِنَّ الظَّالِمِينَ فِي عَذابٍ مُقِيمٍ».
For الظالمين was put in place of the pronoun which properly should have referred to the ism of إنّ, so that it would be said: ألا إنّهم في عذاب مقيم; this overt noun came to record against them, by naming it, their wrongdoing. This is of the badīʿ (rhetorical embellishment) that rises above people of thought and the creative.

safi-cedvel:44-46.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya). (من) a jussive-governing conditional noun (ism sharṭ), in the position of accusative as a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (يضلل) jussive (majzūm), given a kasra because of the meeting of two vowelless letters. (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). (ما) negating, non-governing (muhmala). (له) attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate). (وليّ) genitive in form, nominative in position, a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). (من بعده) attached to a naʿt (adjective) of (وليّ). (الواو) resumptive. (لمّا) an adverb meaning حين (when), stripped of the conditional sense, attached to (ترى). (رأوا) past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma implied on the alif deleted because of the meeting of two vowelless letters. (هل) interrogative particle. (إلى مردّ) attached to an omitted fronted khabar. (سبيل) genitive in form by the redundant من, nominative in position, a postponed mubtadaʾ.
The clause «يضلل الله ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «ما له من وليّ ...» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «ترى ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «رأوا ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
The clause «يقولون ...» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of الظالمين.
The clause «هل إلى مردّ من سبيل» is in the position of accusative as maqūl al-qawl (the object of speech).
45- (الواو) conjunction. (عليها) attached to (يعرضون). (خاشعين) ḥāl of the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). (من الذلّ) attached to (خاشعين). (من طرف) attached to (ينظرون). (الواو) resumptive. The second (الذين) is in the position of nominative as khabar of إنّ. (يوم) an accusative adverb of time attached to (خسروا) — or to (قال). (ألا) for drawing attention (tanbīh). (في عذاب) attached to the khabar of the second إنّ.
The clause «تراهم ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause ترى الظالمين.
The clause «يعرضون ...» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the third-person pronoun in (تراهم).
The clause «ينظرون ...» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the pronoun in خاشعين.
The clause «قال الذين ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «آمنوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the first relative noun (الذين).
The clause «إنّ الخاسرين الذين ...» is in the position of accusative as maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «خسروا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the second relative noun (الذين).
The clause «إنّ الظالمين في عذاب» has no grammatical position, being resumptive [Note: It may also be in the position of accusative as maqūl al-qawl of an implied saying, namely the saying of Allah.].
46- (الواو) conjunction. (ما) negating. (لهم) the fronted khabar of كان. (أولياء) genitive in form by the redundant (من), nominative in position as the ism of كان; it is prevented from nunation because it is assimilated to the feminine ending in the elongated alif of femininity, on the pattern أفعلاء. (من دون) attached to a ḥāl of the agent of ينصرون. (الواو) resumptive. (من يضلل الله فما له من سبيل) is like من يضلل الله فما له من وليّ [Note: in verse (44) of this sura.]..
The clause «ما كان لهم من أولياء» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause إنّ الظالمين ...
The clause «ينصرونهم ...» is in the position of genitive — or nominative, according to the position — as a naʿt of أولياء.
The clause «يضلل الله ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «ما له من سبيل» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.

* Rhetoric:
Splendid depiction: in the saying of Allah the Exalted «يَنْظُرُونَ مِنْ طَرْفٍ خَفِيٍّ».
A masterful embodiment and a splendid depiction of one who stands before the death that awaits him: their looking begins with a weak, hidden movement of their eyelids, by stealth, just as you see the man held for execution looking at the sword. Such is the look of one who looks at hateful things: he cannot open his eyelids upon them and fill his eyes with them, as he does when he looks at a beloved.

safi-cedvel:47-48.t:
* I'rab:
(لربّكم) attached to (mutaʿalliq) (استجيبوا). (من قبل) attached to (استجيبوا). (أن) a maṣdar-forming particle governing the accusative. (لا) the lā of generic negation. (له) attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of لا. (من الله) attached to the mīmī maṣdar (مردّ)..
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يأتي..) is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
(ما لكم من ملجأ) is like ما له من وليّ «1». (يومئذ) an adverb of time annexed to the adverb إذ, attached to the maṣdar (ملجأ). (الواو) conjunction. (ما لكم من نكير) is like the first «2». [Translator's note: the footnote markers «1» and «2» appear in the source without their footnote text.]
The clause «استجيبوا ...» is in the position of accusative as maqūl al-qawl (the object of speech) of an implied saying, which is resumptive.
The clause «يأتي يوم ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle relative (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī) (أن).
The clause «لا مردّ له ...» is in the position of genitive as a naʿt (adjective) of يوم.
The clause «ما لكم من ملجأ ...» has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) [Note: or it is a second naʿt of يوم, with the linking pronoun implied, i.e. "you will have no refuge in it"; likewise the conjoined clause ما لكم من نكير.].
The clause «ما لكم من نكير» has no grammatical position, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the explanatory resumption.
48- (الفاء) conjunction. (أعرضوا) past verb, in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). (ما) negating. (عليهم) attached to the ḥāl (circumstantial) (حفيظا). (إن) a particle of negation. (عليك) fronted khabar. (إلّا) for restriction (ḥaṣr). (البلاغ) postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative. (الواو) resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya). (منّا) attached to a ḥāl of رحمة [Note: or attached to (أذقنا), with من for the beginning of the extent (ibtidāʾ al-ghāya).]. (بها) attached to (فرح). (الواو) conjunction. (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle (ḥarf maṣdarī) [Note: or a relative noun in the position of genitive, with the resumptive pronoun omitted.]. (الفاء) linking.
The interpreted maṣdar (ما قدّمت ...) is in the position of genitive by the causal (الباء), attached to (تصبهم).
The clause «أعرضوا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the implied resumptive clause of saying.
The clause «ما أرسلناك ...» has no grammatical position, being a causal explanation of the implied apodosis, i.e.: if they turn away, then do not grieve, for We have not sent you ... [Note: The clause may be the apodosis itself, according to the apparent sense.].
The clause «إن عليك إلّا البلاغ ...» has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption.
The clause «إنّا إذا ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «the condition, its protasis and its apodosis ...» is in the position of nominative as khabar of إنّ.
The clause «أذقنا ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «فرح ...» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «تصبهم سيئة ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause إنّا إذا ...
The clause «قدّمت أيديهم ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle relative (ما).
The clause «إنّ الإنسان كفور ...» has no grammatical position, being a causal explanation of the implied apodosis, i.e.:
if an evil befalls them, they are ungrateful for the blessing and mention the affliction; indeed man is ungrateful.

* Benefits:
- لا: of generic negation..
It is so called because it negates the generality of the genus. When I say: لا رجل في الدار (there is no man in the house), I negate the genus of men. So it is not permissible to say: (لا رجل في الدار بل رجلين) (there is no man in the house, but rather two men). For it to govern there are conditions:
1- That it not be accompanied by a preposition, e.g. (سافرت بلا زاد) (I travelled without provisions).
2- That its ism and khabar be indefinite.
3- That nothing separate it from its ism, e.g. (لا في التقصير ولا في الإهمال نجاح) (there is no success in shortcoming nor in neglect).
The lā of generic negation has occurred in the verse we are dealing with as governing, its conditions for governing being fulfilled, namely the saying of Allah the Exalted (لا مَرَدَّ لَهُ مِنَ اللَّهِ). As for its ism, it is indeclinable (mabnī) if it is single (mufrad), i.e. neither annexed (muḍāf) nor resembling the annexed, e.g.: لا رجل في الدار، لا رجلين في الدار، لا مهملين بيننا، لا مهملات بيننا. In these examples the ism of (لا) has come indeclinable on that by which it is put in the accusative; so, according to the order of the sentences, it is indeclinable on the fatḥa, on the yāʾ in the dual, on the yāʾ in the sound masculine plural, and on the kasra in the sound feminine plural. It comes in the accusative if it is:
a- Annexed, e.g.: لا رجل سوء محبوب (no man of evil is loved).
b- Resembling the annexed: لا فاعلا سوءا محبوب (no doer of evil is loved).

safi-cedvel:49-50.t:
* I'rab:
(لله) attached to (mutaʿalliq) a fronted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) (ملك). (ما) relative noun, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (لمن) attached to (يهب) in both places..
The clause «لله ملك ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «يخلق ...» has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «يشاء ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (ما).
The clause «يهب ...» has no grammatical position, being a badal (substitute) of the clause يخلق.
The clause «يشاء (the second)» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (من).
The clause «يهب (the second)» has no grammatical position, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause يهب (the first).
The clause «يشاء (the third)» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the second relative noun (من).
50- (أو) conjunction. (ذكرانا) second mafʿūl bihi, by making the verb include the sense of يجعلهم (He makes them) [Note: It may be a ḥāl (circumstantial) of classification from the third-person pronoun in (يزوّجهم).]. (عقيما) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb).
The clause «يزوّجهم ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause يهب..
The clause «يجعل ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause يزوّجهم.
The clause «يشاء ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (من).
The clause «إنّه عليم ...» has no grammatical position, being causal (taʿlīliyya) — or an explanatory resumption.

* Rhetoric:
The art of sound division (ṣiḥḥat al-taqsīm): in the saying of Allah the Exalted «يَهَبُ لِمَنْ يَشاءُ إِناثاً وَيَهَبُ لِمَنْ يَشاءُ الذُّكُورَ أَوْ يُزَوِّجُهُمْ». This art is the speaker's exhausting all the divisions of the meaning he has embarked upon, so that he leaves nothing of it out. For He, glory be to Him, either singles out the servant with the gift of females, or with the gift of males, or with both together, or gives him nothing. Sound division has occurred in this verse in the order that eloquence calls for, namely moving, in the arrangement and composition of speech, from the lower to the higher: He put first the gift of females, then moved to the gift of males, then to the gift of both together. In each division of the bestowal He used the word of gift (الهبة), and He set apart the meaning of deprivation by putting it last, because His bestowing blessings on His servants is more important to Him, and putting the more important first is required in all eloquent speech. The verse was brought only to enumerate the blessings, and He mentioned deprivation only to complete the self-praise with the power to withhold, just as one is praised for giving; so it is known that there is none to withhold what He gives, and none to give what He withholds.

safi-cedvel:51-53.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya). (ما) negating. (لبشر) attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of كان. (أن) a maṣdar-forming particle governing the accusative. (إلّا) for exception [Note: or for restriction (ḥaṣr).]. (وحيا) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, standing in for the maṣdar because it is a quasi-maṣdar (ism maṣdar), i.e. "except that He reveals to him a revelation" [Note: It may be a maṣdar in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the Name of Majesty or of the third-person pronoun in يكلّمه.].
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يكلّمه..) is in the position of nominative as the ism of كان.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يوحى..) is in the position of accusative on the disconnected exception (al-istithnāʾ al-munqaṭiʿ) — if revelation is other than speaking — or the connected one (muttaṣil) if revelation is a kind of speaking or speaking is a kind of revelation.
(أو) conjunction. (من وراء) attached to an omitted element conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the governor of (وحيا), i.e.: "or except that He speaks to him from behind a veil".. or "causing him to hear from behind a veil". (يرسل) imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after أو [Note: The implication here is permissible because it is preceded by an explicit maṣdar.]..
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يرسل..) is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the explicit maṣdar (وحيا).
(الفاء) conjunction. (يوحي) imperfect verb, accusative, conjoined to (يرسل). (بإذنه) attached to a ḥāl of the agent of يوحي [Note: who is the angel messenger to the human recipient.], and the third-person pronoun in (بإذنه) refers to Allah. (ما) relative noun, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) [Note: or a qualified indefinite noun (nakira mawṣūfa) in the position of accusative.], and the agent of يشاء is a pronoun referring to Allah..
The clause «ما كان لبشر ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «يكلّمه الله ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle relative (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī) (أن).
The clause «يرسل ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the implied particle relative (أن).
The clause «يوحي ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause يرسل.
The clause «يشاء ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (ما) [Note: or in the position of accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of (ما).].
The clause «إنّه عليّ ...» has no grammatical position, being causal (taʿlīliyya).
52- (الواو) conjunction. (كذلك) attached to an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq whose governor is أوحينا. (إليك) attached to (أوحينا). (من أمرنا) attached to a naʿt of (روحا). The first (ما) is a particle of negation; the second (ما) is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), whose khabar is (الكتاب) [Note: In the speech a muḍāf is implied, i.e.: you did not know the answer to (ما الكتاب), i.e. the answer to this question.]. (لا) redundant (zāʾida) for emphasizing the negation. (الإيمان) conjoined to الكتاب, nominative like it. (الواو) conjunction. (لكن) for rectification (istidrāk), with no governing effect. (نورا) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (به) attached to (نهدي). (من عبادنا) attached to a ḥāl of the implied resumptive pronoun, i.e. "whose guidance We will from among Our servants". (الواو) resumptive. (اللام) the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa) for emphasis. (إلى صراط) attached to (تهدي).
The clause «أوحينا إليك ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause ما كان لبشر.
